# Ossuary Atelier

> Ossuary Atelier is a Phuket-based secondhand and culture project. It began as a
> curated thrift clothing archive and grew into a local guide: a directory of
> Phuket secondhand shops, an interactive map, a Thai slang glossary, small
> browser tools, and this record of the island's underground — art, skate, and
> the things worth keeping. We are not against new technology; we are exploring
> how to use it in healthy, creative, human ways. No tracking cookies, no
> personal data collection, no cart — every sale is a conversation.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ossuaryphuket.me/): what Ossuary Atelier is and where to start.
- [Phuket Thrift Guide](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/): the live hub — shops, notes, map and tools.
- [Phuket Nature Safety Guide](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/safety/): a citation-backed field guide to the island's living hazards — jellyfish, snakes, poisons, rip currents, tsunami, heat and dengue.
- [Specimen Atlas](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/safety/atlas.html): every hazard in the guide, photographed and licensed, with names, hazards and full image credits.
- [Deep Dives](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/safety/deep-dives.html): the evidence behind the guide — Thai clinical data, case reviews and reef surveys, with every source named.
- [Field Notes](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/safety/field-notes.html): incidents on Phuket's beaches and trails, rewritten and linked to the original reporting.
- [Field Reference](https://ossuaryphuket.me/guide/safety/reference.html): emergency numbers, a first-aid matrix, beach flags, hospital and hyperbaric directories, a quiz and full sources.
- [Thrift Directory](https://ossuaryphuket.me/blog/guide/): honest reviews of Phuket secondhand shops.
- [Shop](https://ossuaryphuket.me/shop.html): current and archived pieces, each with a written story.
- [The Osteology](https://ossuaryphuket.me/blog/): the journal — piece stories, shop reviews and field notes.
- [About](https://ossuaryphuket.me/about.html): the story, philosophy and where it is going.
- [How It Works](https://ossuaryphuket.me/how-it-works.html): sourcing, research and documentation.
- [Contact](https://ossuaryphuket.me/contact.html): claim a piece or get in touch.

## Tools

- [Phuket Map](https://ossuaryphuket.me/tools/phuket-map/): open, downloadable map of thrift spots and beaches.
- [Thai Slang Glossary](https://ossuaryphuket.me/tools/slang-glossary/): 50 everyday and deep-cut Thai terms.
- [Fretboard Trainer](https://ossuaryphuket.me/tools/fretboard-trainer/): a free multi-tuning guitar trainer.
- [Guess the Beach](https://ossuaryphuket.me/tools/guess-the-beach/): a daily Phuket beach-guessing game.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://ossuaryphuket.me/privacy.html): cookie-free policy.
- [Terms](https://ossuaryphuket.me/tos.html): purchase terms.
